instruction.text: Match these common abbreviations to their meanings.
Which of these abbreviations is not a day of the week?
Choose the abbreviation that fits in the gap.

atoms.a: Mr Iqbal is my favourite teacher.
atoms.b: ((++Mr Dr Ms)) Iqbal is my favourite teacher.

atoms.a: Arabic is the main language of the United Arab Emirates.
atoms.b: Arabic is the main language of the ((++UAE USA UK)).

atoms.a: My middle finger is two inches long.
atoms.b: My middle finger is 2 ((++in m km)) long.

atoms.a: The swimming pool is 50 meters long.
atoms.b: The swimming pool is 50 ((++m in km)) long.
